settings.editor: Our Sunshine Coast content creators live and breathe video marketing and professional photography. At Pepper, we dive deep into your business to get to know your target audience and create strategic content that will drive growth.

We work with businesses across the Sunshine Coast and beyond to help them cut through the noise and connect with their audience on an emotional level. Whether you need video marketing for social media, YouTube, emails to customers or for your website, our content is designed to get you results.

Our team is highly experienced in video capture, production and strategic content delivery. From start to finish, let our experienced team deliver the results you want.

image.alt: Pepper Productions filming on location on the Sunshine Coast

settings.title: We think about the end game.

settings.editor:
When we create videos for your marketing needs, we think about the real reason you need this video. Whether it's product sales, brand awareness, enquiries, or client acquisition, your goal is our main focus throughout the entire project.

That's what takes your video project from simple content to a business growth tool — and we deliver effective video campaigns that drive sales, traffic and engagement.

Pepper Productions is a division of the Sunshine Coast's leading marketing agency Chilli, which has been achieving great results for businesses since 1993.

This partnership allows our in-house team of storytellers to get the best results from your content. Be it online, on social media, or for corporate and trade events, we make sure your project is on time, on budget and — most importantly — that it gets results.

settings.title: A full production team, fully kitted.
The Pepper Vans, our mobile studios.

settings.editor:
We run two. The first is a fully-kitted 4X4 adventure van, hard to come by in Australia, built for remote location shooting and overnight stays on bigger productions — solar panels, lithium batteries, shore power and a 3000W inverter, so there's never a wait on charge halfway through a shoot.

The second is a 2026 Transit Custom Trail: our dedicated day-to-day production and grip van, smaller and easier to place on a tight job, still tough enough for a work site.

They keep the kit in prime condition and give everyone somewhere to review footage, get changed, sit in the shade and get a coffee. On a long day outdoors, that is not a small thing.
